mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below previous month by >0.2pp
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index over three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment over three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the housing starts index over three consecutive months signals strengthening residential investment, which boosts construction-related earnings and triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months combined with a decline in payroll employment signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp AND PAYEMS falls in same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).
